label: Activity rings
desc: Three concentric progress rings that fill on mount, with a legend of values and a Replay button.
use: dashboard summary card, goals or usage progress, onboarding checklist

label: Command input
desc: A text field with a slash-command menu (listbox), file drop and attach chips, submitting text, files and command together.
use: dashboard composer, support or feedback box, publishing notes, search with commands

label: Detent dial
desc: A rotary dial with detents you can drag, flick (it coasts and snaps with a small overshoot), or set with arrow keys and the wheel.
use: settings page, level or quality picker, dashboard control

label: Step progress list
desc: A list of steps that move from pending to active to done with a spinner and check, driven by props or autoplay.
use: publishing list, long-running job, connect page, import or build progress

label: Tear-off confirm
desc: A confirm button with a perforated stub: drag it off or press Space on it to confirm, then Reset.
use: sign-in confirmation, publish or delete confirmation, checkout, landing call to action

label: Bell button
desc: A button whose bell icon swings with a damped ring and a badge count when clicked (visual only, no sound).
use: dashboard header, notifications entry, subscribe or remind-me button
